summary: Iteration 12: Tested WATH Carnival separation from Scholarships, atomic slot booking, admin config, and UI. 13/14 backend tests pass. CRITICAL backend bug found: try_reserve_slot allows over-booking because upsert=True with a $lt filter creates a duplicate counter doc when the slot is full instead of failing. Frontend UI (public /wath carnival mode, admin /admin WATH Management) works: mode cards, slot picker with disabled full slots, toast validation, registrations drawer grouped by slot.

critical.issue: Over-booking possible. wath_carnival.try_reserve_slot uses find_one_and_update with filter {booked_count: {$lt: capacity}} + upsert=True. When the counter doc already exists and is full (booked_count==capacity), the filter no longer matches so Mongo performs an UPSERT and INSERTS A SECOND counter document with booked_count=1. There is no unique index on (carnival_id,date,time), so the insert succeeds and the function returns True, allowing unlimited over-booking. The subsequent /api/wath/page hydration also reads only the first counter via find({...}).to_list, but even summing wouldn't fix the correctness gap. Verified via automated over-book test: capacity=1, 2 registrations both returned 200 (expected 2nd = 409).

action_items: Fix wath_carnival.try_reserve_slot to prevent over-booking. Recommended: (a) add a unique index on wath_slot_counts (carnival_id, date, time) so upsert of a duplicate raises DuplicateKeyError; combined with the $lt filter this makes over-booking impossible atomically. (b) OR remove upsert and pre-create the counter doc with booked_count:0 when the carnival is created/updated, then only the $inc happens under the $lt guard. Also handle the DuplicateKeyError branch to return False.
critical_code_review_comments: wath_carnival._hydrate_carnival: If two counter docs existed for the same slot (see bug), only the first is used because dict merge in by_key overwrites — masks the bug in reads.

wath_carnival._get_page_config default returns key present but system_meta.update_one uses $set with 'key' — safe. However, DELETE carnival that is active flips mode to 'exam' but doesn't clear active_carnival_id atomically with mode — fine because both set together.

WATH.jsx modal form (fallback) does NOT include the CarnivalSlotPicker or handle carnival_id — users opening the hero modal in carnival mode can only submit via scholarship_id path, which will fail with 400 'scholarship_id or carnival_id required'. Consider hiding modal button in carnival mode or wiring the picker into the modal form too.
WATH.jsx inline form disables submit when `busy || (!campaign && !isCarnival)` but the modal form disables on `busy || !campaign` — inconsistent when in carnival mode.

server.py apply_scholarship: When carnival is active, dup email/phone check happens BEFORE try_reserve_slot — but if try_reserve_slot succeeds and insert_one fails, release_slot is called. Good. But if slot reservation happens and duplicate email check missed a race, the release is not invoked (the raise in dup path is before the reserve so ok). Overall ordering is safe.
server.py /api/scholarships filters out kind=wath but does not filter carnivals (they live in wath_carnivals collection anyway) — OK.
seed_data_creation: Test file creates and cleans up temporary TEST_ carnivals for over-book / duplicate / registrations tests. No permanent DB pollution.

rca of the issue:
RCA — Over-booking in WATH Carnival slot reservation:

Code: /app/backend/wath_carnival.py:212-220
```
res = await db.wath_slot_counts.find_one_and_update(
  {"carnival_id": cid, "date": d, "time": t, "booked_count": {"$lt": capacity}},
  {"$inc": {"booked_count": 1}, "$setOnInsert": {"capacity": capacity}},
  upsert=True, return_document=True)
if res and int(res.get("booked_count", 0)) <= capacity: return True
```

When the slot's counter doc reaches booked_count == capacity, the filter no longer matches. Because upsert=True, MongoDB then performs an INSERT of a NEW counter document (with booked_count:1). Since there is NO unique index on (carnival_id,date,time), the insert succeeds, res.booked_count is 1, and the function returns True — allowing infinite over-books.

Reproduction: create carnival with capacity=1, POST /api/scholarship-applications twice with different emails but same carnival_id/chosen_date/chosen_slot_time. Both return 200 (expected 2nd = 409).

Mitigation: (1) Add unique index db.wath_slot_counts.create_index([(carnival_id,1),(date,1),(time,1)], unique=True) on startup — then upsert of a duplicate raises DuplicateKeyError which caller can catch and return False. (2) OR pre-create counter docs when carnival is created/updated with booked_count:0 and drop upsert=True; the $lt filter alone will then correctly fail to match a full slot and return None.
